bundle.shortDescription: Local GGUF persona studio — own your models and characters.
bundle.longDescription: LocalPersona is a desktop application for creating and chatting with rich AI personas powered exclusively by local GGUF models via llama.cpp. Everything stays on your machine: characters, conversations, and knowledge documents are real files you control. Models and llama-server are not bundled — configure them in Settings.
